## My idea or exact wording

Paste the idea here.

## What I mean and what supports it

Add relevant definitions, context, evidence or derivation. State any claim you are deliberately leaving unproved. For word-role assignments, include the complete sentence and intended reading.

## What would help

For example: identify understatement, preserve my phrasing, assess support for the claim, or explain what would strengthen or narrow it.

The owner can request this review in the bot repository. It uses the existing API connection and replies publicly on this issue. Confidence is a qualitative assessment of the claim, not a grade of the author or a formal proof.
